app.UG93ZXJQb2ludA.action.cmVhZA.option..source: Read a table as row data
Type of content to read: `slides` (default) or `table`

app.UG93ZXJQb2ludA.action.cmVhZA.option..source: Index of slide for table mode (0-based)
